items:
REMOVE AIR INTAKE CHAMBER
(See steps 1 to 10 on pages FI-49 to 50)

content.description: Illustration of fuel injector with cover labeled, showing the injector body with ribbed design and electrical connector

items: (a) Remove the four bolts, and then remove the delivery pipe with injectors.

content.text: When removing the delivery pipe, be careful not to drop the injectors.
Do not remove the injector cover.

items: (b) Remove the six insulators from the intake manifold.

content.text: Keep clear of sparks during the test.

items: (a) Connect the SST to the fuel filter outlet.

content.description: Diagram showing SST tool connected to fuel filter outlet with original pipe labeled

items: (b) Connect the SST to the pressure regulator and the injector.
(c) Hold the injector and hose with SST.

content.description: Diagram showing SST tool holding injector with vinyl tube and hose connections

items: (d) Put the injector into the graduated cylinder.

content.text: Install a suitable vinyl tube onto the injector to prevent gasoline from splashing out.

items: (e) Connect the ground cable to the battery.
(g) Using a service wire, short both terminals of the fuel pump check connector.

content.description: Diagram showing location of fuel pump check connector in the engine compartment
